items.text: Thank you for showing me. Let's let it go together.
So this feeling was here. Thank you for telling me.
We don't need the reason. That was hard. I'm here with you.
I'm not angry. As much as you've shown me, let's make it lighter together.
You've been carrying this a long time. You can set it down now.
I'm sorry I ignored you. I'm listening now.
Thank you for telling me, "there's a memory here."
You don't have to hold it alone. Let's speak to it together.
No need to hurry. We can let go as many times as it takes.
I love you. Memory and all, I love you.
We noticed, so it's okay. From here, we're together.
Thank you for today. Good night. Leave the rest to me.
